title: Egyptian Civil Code — Article ٩
text:
تسرى في شأن الأدلة التي تعد مقدماً النصوص المعمول بها في الوقت
الذي كان ينبغي فيه إعداده .

--- English Translation ---

Proof established in advance is governed by provisions of
the law in force at the time when the proof was
established or at the time when such proof should have
been established.
